name: NBP EUR/PLN Daily Exchange Rate
description: 255 days of historical daily midpoint exchange rates for the Euro against the Polish Zloty, sourced directly from the National Bank of Poland.

etl.script: WITH raw_data AS (SELECT UNNEST(rates) AS rate_record FROM read_json_auto('http://api.nbp.pl/api/exchangerates/rates/a/eur/last/255/?format=json')) SELECT CAST(rate_record.effectiveDate AS TIMESTAMP) AS date, CAST(rate_record.mid AS FLOAT32) AS rate FROM raw_data;
